np: NP is a radioactive transuranic metallic element.
NP can also mean a registered nurse who has received special training and can perform many of the duties of a physician.
NP means the same as neptunium or atomic number 93 or nurse practitioner.
npa: NPA is a terrorist organization that is the militant wing of the Communist Party of the Philippines.
NPA means the same as New People's Army.
npc: NPC is an agency that serves as the focal point for all Intelligence Community activities related to nonproliferation of weapons of mass destruction and their missile delivery systems.
NPC means the same as Nonproliferation Center.
